## Type of change
<!--

## Checklist
<!--
  Check each item after completing it. These steps help ensure that changes
  are consistent with the HawkDrive ecosystem's development standards.

  Contributors are responsible for understanding and validating all submitted
  changes, including code produced with AI assistance.
-->

- [ ] I understand my changes and have reviewed them for correctness.
- [ ] I have run `hd sync` to synchronize the repository.
- [ ] I have run `prek run` to format and validate the code.
- [ ] I have tested my changes on physical hardware, where applicable, and verified the expected behavior.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where applicable.
- [ ] I have reviewed any affected generated code for correctness.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation where applicable.
